# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Not sure if Spotify library search will return exact title matches; will check returned titles and paginate.</uncertainty>

playlist_title = 'Spotify R&B Recommendations'

# Find existing playlist(s)
existing = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, query=playlist_title, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('show_playlist_library page', page_index, 'type', type(resp))
    if isinstance(resp, dict) and 'message' in resp:
        raise RuntimeError(resp['message'])
    playlists = resp
    if isinstance(resp, dict) and 'success' in resp:
        playlists = resp['success']
    if not playlists:
        break
    # collect exact title matches
    for pl in playlists:
        if pl.get('title') == playlist_title:
            existing.append(pl)
    print('found_in_page', len(playlists), 'exact_matches_total_so_far', len(existing))
    page_index += 1

print('existing_exact_count', len(existing))
if existing:
    playlist_id = existing[0]['playlist_id']
    print('using_existing_playlist_id', playlist_id)
else:
    create_resp = apis.spotify.create_playlist(title=playlist_title, access_token=spotify_token)
    print('create_playlist_resp', create_resp)
    playlist_id = create_resp.get('playlist_id')
    print('created_playlist_id', playlist_id)

# Get current songs in playlist (to avoid re-adding duplicates)
pl_resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=spotify_token)
print('show_playlist_resp_keys', pl_resp.keys())
existing_song_ids = set([s.get('id') for s in pl_resp.get('songs', []) if s.get('id') is not None])
print('existing_song_count', len(existing_song_ids))

# <playbook_cite>Following entry: Token/login management + Problem Solving Heuristics — log in once; filter recommended tracks by required metadata</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Not sure if genre matching must be exact 'R&B' or includes variants; will accept case-insensitive substring 'r&b'.</uncertainty>

from datetime import datetime

def parse_year(dt_str):
    if not dt_str:
        return None
    try:
        # expected format like '2022-05-21T21:55:36'
        return datetime.fromisoformat(dt_str).year
    except Exception:
        # fallback: take first 4 characters
        try:
            return int(str(dt_str)[:4])
        except Exception:
            return None

selected_song_ids = set()
selected_song_details = []

for rec in all_recs:
    sid = rec.get('song_id')
    if sid is None:
        continue
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre = song.get('genre')
    rel = song.get('release_date')
    year = parse_year(rel)

    genre_match = False
    if isinstance(genre, str):
        if 'r&b' in genre.lower().replace('and','&').replace(' ', ''):
            genre_match = True
        elif 'rnb' in genre.lower().replace('&','').replace(' ', '') and 'r&b' in 'rnb':
            # unlikely; keep conservative
            genre_match = False

    # also accept exact genre
    if isinstance(genre, str) and genre.lower() == 'r&b':
        genre_match = True

    if genre_match and year in {last_year, current_year}:
        selected_song_ids.add(sid)
        selected_song_details.append((sid, song.get('title'), genre, year))

print('recommended_song_count', len(all_recs))
print('selected_rnb_release_year_song_count', len(selected_song_ids))
print('selected_song_ids_sample', sorted(selected_song_ids)[:10])

already_in_playlist = selected_song_ids & existing_song_ids
to_add_song_ids = list(selected_song_ids - existing_song_ids)
print('already_in_playlist_that_match_criteria', len(already_in_playlist))
print('to_add_song_count', len(to_add_song_ids))
print('to_add_sample', to_add_song_ids[:10])

# <playbook_cite>Following entry: Strategies And Hard Rules — act on required subset only; omit optional parameters</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Will add songs one-by-one; unsure if playlist API supports bulk add.</uncertainty>

add_results = []
for sid in to_add_song_ids:
    res = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    add_results.append(res)

print('added_count_reported', len(add_results))
print('first_add_result', add_results[0] if add_results else None)

# Verification (single pass): check final playlist contains exactly the expected set
final_pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=spotify_token)
final_song_ids = set([s.get('id') for s in final_pl.get('songs', []) if s.get('id') is not None])
expected_final_song_ids = existing_song_ids | selected_song_ids

print('existing_song_count_before', len(existing_song_ids))
print('expected_final_song_count', len(expected_final_song_ids))
print('final_song_count_after', len(final_song_ids))
print('final_equals_expected', final_song_ids == expected_final_song_ids)
print('missing_from_final_expected', expected_final_song_ids - final_song_ids)
print('extra_in_final_not_expected', final_song_ids - expected_final_song_ids)
